app.name: Pawprint
app.disclaimer: Unofficial tool. Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.
download.title: Download
download.failed: Could not reach GitHub to list the downloads.
download.mod.title: Mod
download.mod.body: A building planner: design with ghost blocks, then build along with them, wrong blocks marked. Client only, so it works on any server and never places blocks for you.
download.mod.fabricApi: The Fabric versions also need Fabric API.
download.mod.install: Put the jar in the mods folder of your game (or instance) and start Minecraft.
download.app.title: Desktop app
download.app.body: This editor as an app: finds your installed Minecraft to make block packs, opens .pawprint files on double-click and lets panels have their own windows.
download.app.unsigned: The installers are not code-signed: Windows SmartScreen and macOS warn on first start.
projects.title: Projects
projects.empty.title: No blueprints yet
projects.empty.body: Open a .pawprint file to view it in 3D. Add a block pack first so blocks show with their real textures.
packs.title: Block packs
packs.intro: A block pack holds the block list, names, shapes and textures. Packs you make from your own game are stored in this browser only and are never uploaded.
packs.empty.title: No block packs yet
packs.empty.body: You can still edit without one: blocks then show as plain colored boxes.
packs.add.title: Add a pack
packs.add.openHelp: From the mod: in game press B → Library → "Export block pack". Modded blocks and your resource packs come along.
packs.add.jarHelp: Vanilla blocks only, English names. Pick .minecraft/versions/<version>/<version>.jar.
packs.installs.title: Minecraft on this computer
packs.installs.help: Vanilla blocks, with names in every language the launcher downloaded. For other launchers pick the folder that has versions/ and assets/ (CurseForge: minecraft/Install).
packs.partialProperties: Block properties were guessed from the game files; some may be missing.
packs.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}"? Blueprints keep their blocks, but they will show as plain boxes until you add a pack again.
packs.confirmReplace: "{name}" is already here. Replace it with this file?
projects.drop: Drop a .pawprint file here to open it
editor.noPack: No block pack: blocks show as plain boxes. Add one under Block packs.
editor.missing: {count} kinds of blocks are not in the pack (checkered boxes)
editor.help: Right-drag look · Right + WASD move · Q/E down/up · Wheel forward/back · Right + wheel speed · Middle-drag pan · F fit
projects.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}"? This cannot be undone. Download it first if you want to keep a copy.
editor.notFound: This project is not in this browser.
editor.loadFailed: The project could not be opened.
editor.saveFailed: Saving failed. Your changes are still here; try again or download the file.
editor.name: Blueprint name
editor.fillHelp: Fills the connected area of the same block on this layer.
editor.pickerHelp: Click a block to paint with it (Alt+click with any tool).
editor.fillTooLarge: That area is too large to fill. Close it in first.
editor.help2d: Left click paint · Wheel zoom · Right or middle drag pan · Alt+click pick · PgUp/PgDn layer
editor.noPackPalette: Without a block pack there is no block list. Type a block ID to paint with it.
editor.solidHelp: Drag the footprint; it grows away from the face you start on (in 2D: upward through the layers).
editor.selectHelp: Drag across blocks (3D: from one corner block to the other). Delete clears, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X copy.
editor.stampHelp: Click to place · R turn · X / Z mirror · Esc stop
editor.noClip: Nothing to stamp yet: copy a selection (Ctrl+C) or pick one from Stamps.
editor.stampsHelp: Any blueprint can be a stamp. Saved stamps (★) come first.
layers.title: Layers
layers.add: New layer above the selected one
layers.mergeDown: Move this layer's blocks into the layer below it
layers.delete: Delete the layer and its blocks
layers.confirmDelete: Delete "{name}" and every block on it? Undo (Ctrl+Z) brings the blocks back.
layers.renameHint: Click to draw on this layer · double-click to rename
layers.help: New blocks go to the highlighted layer. Painting over another layer's block moves it here. Drag rows to reorder or into groups. Hidden and locked layers cannot be changed.

window.title: Window
window.popout: Move this panel to its own window
window.popoutHelp: Panel windows come back when you reopen the app.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Block names follow the language too, when the block pack has it.
credits.title: Credits & licenses
credits.app: A blueprint editor for Minecraft builds, made with the Pawprint mod.
credits.minecraft: Block textures and models come from block packs made from your own game; none are included here.
credits.fontChanges: Changed by Pawprint: Hangul moved down 1px to line up with Latin letters, renamed "Silver Pawprint", split by Unicode range.
intro.welcome.title: Welcome to Pawprint
intro.welcome.body: Look at Minecraft blueprints in 3D and 2D and edit them layer by layer, with brushes, shapes, stamps and layers. Open .pawprint files from the Pawprint mod, or start a new one. Everything stays on this computer.
intro.packs.title: Blocks come from a block pack
intro.packs.body: A block pack holds block names, shapes and textures. Make one from your own game:
intro.packs.mod: With the mod: in game press B → Library → "Export block pack". Modded blocks and resource packs come along.
intro.packs.jar: Without the mod: Block packs → "Make from Minecraft jar" (vanilla blocks).
intro.packs.none: No pack yet? You can still edit; blocks show as plain colored boxes.
intro.controls.title: Basic controls
intro.controls.view3d.label: 3D view
intro.controls.view3d: Right-drag to look, right button + WASD to move, left click to place, F to fit.
intro.controls.view2d.label: 2D slice
intro.controls.view2d: Left click to paint, wheel to zoom, PgUp / PgDn to change layer.
intro.controls.tools.label: Tools
intro.controls.tools: B pencil, E eraser, G fill, I picker, V select, S stamp.
intro.controls.undo.label: Undo
intro.controls.undo: Ctrl+Z, redo Ctrl+Y. Work saves itself a moment after each change.
theme.title: Theme
theme.importFailed: That is not a Pawprint theme file.
theme.contrast: Some text may be hard to read:
theme.contrastPair: {text} on {bg}: contrast {ratio}, should be at least {min}
theme.editHelp: Changes show right away. Pick a color or type any CSS color (rgba for see-through).
theme.builtInHelp: Built-in themes cannot be changed: copy one to edit its colors.
packs.instance.title: From a modpack folder
packs.instance.help: Pick the folder of a modded game (CurseForge: minecraft/Instances/<name>). Blocks, shapes, textures and names are read from the mods and resource packs without starting the game.
packs.instance.limits: Blocks a mod makes only while the game runs, blocks drawn by code (connected textures, machines) and modded leaf colors can be missing or look different. Exporting from the mod in game is exact.
packs.busy.instance.blocks: Finding blocks, models and textures in {name}…
projects.fileChanged: "{name}" changed outside Pawprint since it was last opened or saved here. Open the file as it is now, or keep the version in Pawprint?
fonts.title: Fonts
fonts.help: Order for {language}: each character uses the first font that has it, then Silver, then system fonts.
fonts.badUrl: Give an https link and the font family name it defines.
fonts.tooLarge: That font file is over 30 MB.

editor.viewerHelp: Save a single .html file anyone can open in a browser to look around this blueprint in 3D, with its materials. No install needed.
